title: Pantheon+ redshift factors, host flows and observer lineage

scopes.title: Conditional frame and reconstructed-flow conventions
scopes.checked_claim: Carr Sec5 Eqs2–7 separates heliocentric, observer-corrected CMB and host-PV-corrected Hubble-diagram redshifts through multiplicative frequency-ratio factors; Eqs4–5 fix a projected radial blueshift sign. Peterson SecII.1 Eq7 instead uses a linear radial factor in galactic coordinates. Carr Sec6 Eq9 and Sec6.2–6.3 describe a calibrated, interpolated redshift-space reconstruction and chosen external-flow continuation. Peterson SecIII.2–III.3, SecIV.1 and AppendixA describe catalog-dependent group matching and assumed, posterior-conditioned PV uncertainties. Brout SecIII.1.2–III.1.3 distinguishes light-curve and distance redshift roles and conditioned systematic covariance; Scolnic SecIII.2 p1 retains duplicate-event covariance and searches aliases by RA, DEC and PKMJD.
scopes.unresolved: Complete physical event/frame/clock and observer four-velocity ancestry, exact velocity-grid/group/configuration/calibration ownership, normalization/support and joint covariance remain open. The projected radial prescriptions do not establish a complete Lorentz/frequency-transfer model. Peterson original HTML Eq10's dimensional residual/velocity-width convention and probability measure require original PDF/TeX and implementation clarification before likelihood use. Existing coordinate failures and unknown cross-probe covariance remain blocking.

limitations: Accepted identities are conditional on the declared redshift factors and selected exact source snapshots. Source-adopted dipole, flow parameters, dispersions and fit outputs are not independently measured inputs or physical laws.

Carr's projected square-root Doppler factor and Peterson's linear radial factor remain distinct source prescriptions; neither supplies a checked telescope observer worldline, ephemeris, aberration, coordinate epoch or event clock.

The source reconstruction uses galaxy density, external calibration and group choices with selection and smoothing dependence. Its lack of SN-distance use does not prove joint independence from all shared observations or other galaxy probes.

Peterson Eq10's literal units/normalization are unresolved. Its printed density-weighted comoving-distance prior is not replaced by an inferred volume prior; no executable likelihood, Gaussian law or repair is accepted.

Uncertainty propagation can depend on reconstruction position and produce non-Gaussian or multi-valued redshift inference. Peterson's assumed 250 km/s dispersion and Brout's conditioned 240 km/s floor have different roles; unknown cross-covariance is not zero.

Duplicate aliases and structural CID/epoch linkage do not establish a complete physical event identity. The existing ten coordinate-rounding failures, undefined MJD time scale/flux law and map/event/covariance gates remain open.
No raw arrays, source-output reproduction, native capability, numerical result, held-out independence or cosmological qualification is admitted.
